records.name: Mira Okafor
records.headline: Product designer, founder of Studio Mira
records.bio: Mira has designed banking and travel apps for twelve years and now runs Studio Mira, where she teaches the work behind a good handoff.

records.name: Arjun Mehta
records.headline: Data engineer at a payments company, teaches at Byte School
records.bio: Arjun builds data pipelines by day and teaches Python to people who have never written a line of it.

records.name: Leo Brandt
records.headline: Street photographer, Northlight Academy
records.bio: Leo shoots for magazines and teaches people to see light first and reach for settings second.

records.name: Hana Sato
records.headline: Potter, runs the wheel classes at Kiln & Co
records.bio: Hana trained in Mashiko and has taught wheel-throwing to more than a thousand beginners.

records.name: Ines Varga
records.headline: Baker, Crumb Collective
records.bio: Ines ran a neighbourhood bakery for six years before teaching sourdough to home bakers.

records.name: Tomas Reyes
records.headline: Watercolour painter, teaches on his own
records.bio: Tomas paints the coast of Goa and teaches watercolour the way he learned it: loose, light and every day.

records.name: Noor Haddad
records.headline: Ceramicist, opening her studio on Atelier
records.bio: Noor throws stoneware and has taught evening classes for six years; her studio on Atelier is two days old and holds nothing yet.

records.name: Zara Mehta
records.headline: Workshop host, joining Studio Mira
records.bio: Zara runs Studio Mira's live critiques and was invited to the studio on Atelier this week.
